name: salesforce
description: Salesforce Headless 360 — Salesforce agent skills marketplace.

plugins.name: salesforce-development
plugins.description: Foundation layer for Salesforce platform development — 37 skills for environment validation, project scaffolding, scratch-org lifecycle, declarative metadata, Apex (author, run anonymous, test, debug), flow automation, SOQL, deploy/retrieve, manifest generation, security, code analysis, Well-Architected review, reporting, and generated installed-versus-available capability discovery, plus a read-only architecture-review agent, org-context detection, a production deploy-safety gate, and a bundled Apex + SOQL language server (MCP).

examplePrompts: build a flow
deploy my metadata
run apex tests

plugins.name: experience-lwc
plugins.description: Build and validate Lightning Web Components (LWC): generate components with the PICKLES methodology and 165-point scoring, scaffold a fresh LWC from a Figma design or a PRD, wire-service and Jest test patterns, SLDS styling, WCAG/ARIA accessibility validation, and RTL/TypeScript migration. Use when creating, editing, or reviewing LWC components — touching lwc/**/*.js, .html, .css, or .js-meta.xml files, or asking about wire service, base components, SLDS, Jest LWC tests, or component accessibility.

examplePrompts: build me an LWC datatable
create a lightning web component
convert this Figma design into an LWC
make my component WCAG accessible

plugins.name: experience-react
plugins.description: Build Salesforce React UI Bundle apps: scaffold a new React UI bundle SFDX starter project from a template, generate and edit pages, components, layout, styling, navigation, and branding with shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS, configure ui-bundle metadata, host the app on a Digital Experience Site, and deploy it to an org. Use when creating or editing a React frontend under uiBundles/*/src for a Salesforce site — appLayout.tsx, routes.tsx, src/pages/, src/components/, or when starting, scaffolding, hosting, or deploying a React UI bundle app.

examplePrompts: scaffold a new React UI bundle app
add a shadcn component to my tsx page
build a Digital Experience site with React

plugins.name: experience-cms
plugins.description: Author and source media for Experience Cloud content: apply CMS branding, generate CMS content, search existing Salesforce CMS or Data 360 media, and search and download ethically licensed stock imagery through Salesforce media-management tooling. Use when producing or branding CMS content for a Digital Experience site, locating an existing content asset, or finding a stock image for a page.

examplePrompts: generate CMS content for my site
apply my brand to the Experience Cloud site
find a stock image for this page
search Salesforce CMS for an existing media asset

plugins.name: dx-org-lifecycle
plugins.description: Administer Salesforce environments, Dev Hubs, and sandbox lifecycle: manage or inspect Dev Hub status and scratch allocation, configure and refresh sandboxes, run post-copy automation, provision trials, inspect expiration, assign permission sets, set the default target, and perform package post-install configuration. Use for environment setup and maintenance, especially Dev Hub administration, sandbox refresh, post-copy configuration, time-limited provisioning, access assignment, target selection, or managed-package setup.

examplePrompts: inspect Dev Hub status and show my scratch allocation
configure post-copy steps for my Salesforce sandbox refresh
create a Salesforce trial environment for this demo
switch my default Salesforce target
assign a Salesforce permission set to a user
run post-install configuration for this managed package

plugins.name: dx-devops
plugins.description: Operate Salesforce DevOps Center pipelines and work items and configure their automated testing: manage pipeline definitions and work items, configure test pipelines and suite assignments, run stage test suites, and analyze test failures. Use for DevOps Center pipeline administration, work-item tracking, test-stage configuration, suite execution, quality-gate reruns, or pipeline failure analysis.

examplePrompts: configure a DevOps Center test pipeline
run the test suite for this DevOps Center pipeline stage
analyze why my DevOps Center pipeline tests failed
manage a DevOps Center work item
assign test suites to a DevOps Center stage

plugins.name: platform-trust-security
plugins.description: Protect and govern Salesforce data with Shield Platform Encryption and Salesforce Archive: configure encrypted fields and key-management options, search or restore archived records, monitor ArchiveActivity jobs, analyze retained storage, and mask or erase archived data. Use for encryption metadata and guidance or trusted-services archival and retention workflows.

examplePrompts: configure deterministic Shield Platform Encryption for a new Salesforce field
compare BYOK with external key management for Platform Encryption
search archived Salesforce records by retention criteria
restore archived records with the data-resilience API
monitor ArchiveActivity jobs and download their failure logs

plugins.name: commerce-b2b
plugins.description: Customize an existing Salesforce B2B Commerce storefront with the Salesforce Open Code storefront library: bring the official open-source library into site metadata, map out-of-the-box commerce definitions to storefront equivalents, and swap selected definitions. Use for B2B Commerce library integration, mapping lookup, or replacement work in storefront site metadata.

examplePrompts: integrate Salesforce Open Code into a new local copy of my B2B Commerce storefront
bring the official B2B Commerce open-source library into storefront site metadata
replace OOTB B2B Commerce definitions with mapped site equivalents
map this commerce storefront definition to its equivalent

plugins.name: mobile-development
plugins.description: Build and extend native Salesforce mobile apps on iOS and Android. Bundles skills for scaffolding new Mobile SDK apps, adding Mobile SDK to existing apps, Salesforce authentication, offline storage (SmartStore) and sync (MobileSync), biometric login, native device capabilities, and embedding Agentforce.

examplePrompts: add a new barcode scanning flow with lightning mobile capabilities
add biometric authentication to Salesforce mobile
review Salesforce mobile offline behavior with Komaci
run a Komaci offline priming audit
build a Salesforce iOS app with Mobile SDK
add Mobile SDK to my existing Android app
add MobileSync and SmartStore offline storage to my mobile app
embed an Agentforce agent in my iOS mobile app

plugins.name: platform-observability
plugins.description: Configure Salesforce tracing metadata: generate EventSettings that turn TraceSpanEvent publishing on or off, and generate AgentforcePlatformTracingSettings that forward execution spans into the required Data Cloud ingestion pipeline. Use for API 68 tracing preferences and the two singleton metadata types that control span publication and ingestion.

examplePrompts: turn on TraceSpanEvent publishing with enablePlatformTracing
generate new EventSettings metadata for enablePlatformTracing
forward execution spans with AgentforcePlatformTracingSettings
generate AgentforcePlatformTracingSettings metadata

plugins.name: dx-isv-partner
plugins.description: Support focused Salesforce ISV and partner operations: submit AppAnalyticsQueryRequest records for PackageUsageSummary or SubscriberSnapshot data, configure AppAnalyticsSettings, and set TransactableMarketplaceReceivePartnerOffers for partner-offer reception. Use for managed-package telemetry requests or partner-offer preference changes.

examplePrompts: retrieve PackageUsageSummary for my managed package with AppAnalyticsQueryRequest
request a SubscriberSnapshot with AppAnalyticsQueryRequest
configure AppAnalyticsSettings for managed-package telemetry
set TransactableMarketplaceReceivePartnerOffers to true

plugins.name: service-engagement
plugins.description: Configure Service Cloud digital engagement channels: set up messaging and web chat channels, configure channel deployments, and connect an existing Agentforce channel binding. Use when setting up messaging, web chat, digital engagement deployments, or messaging-site integration.

examplePrompts: set up a Salesforce Digital Engagement messaging channel
configure a Service Cloud web chat deployment
integrate a messaging site with my Salesforce service org

plugins.name: integration
plugins.description: Build Salesforce integrations and event-driven flows: generate connectivity (Named Credentials, External Services, REST/SOAP callouts), configure a Connected App or External Client App for secure OAuth, configure Change Data Capture, and configure event subscriptions. Use when wiring external systems or event-driven architecture — connectivity, connected apps and OAuth, CDC, or event subscription configuration.

examplePrompts: configure a Salesforce Connected App for OAuth
enable Change Data Capture for Account
configure a Salesforce platform event subscription
set up connectivity to an external system
wire an event-driven Salesforce integration

plugins.name: platform-lightning-widgets
plugins.description: Build Lightning Types and Agentforce action widgets: generate type definitions, coordinate Apex-backed widgets and MCP tool result widgets, and generate rich display widgets for these actions. Use when defining a Lightning Type or coordinating its widget for an Agentforce/MCP action.

examplePrompts: generate a custom Salesforce Lightning Type
build an MCP tool widget for this Agentforce action
create a rich display widget for a Lightning Type
